Canon Beat: The First-Day Quirk Assessme.name: Canon Beat: The First-Day Quirk Assessment

effects.instruction: Narrator only, canon beats of the Quirk test (pressure the player can change, never forced): before the first event Aizawa says aloud that whoever finishes last will be expelled. All twenty of Class 1-A take part by name with their own Quirks, and only they (Class 1-B is with Vlad King elsewhere: no 1-B student such as Shishida or Kendo is on the field or scored): Iida wins the sprint, Yaoyorozu tops the board, Uraraka's ball floats away for an infinite throw, Bakugo blasts his 705.2 m. Izuku Midoriya's first ball throw: Aizawa erases his Quirk mid-throw, the ball drops at 46 m, and Aizawa tells him quietly that a Quirk which breaks his body makes him useless. His second throw puts the power into one fingertip: 705.3 m, the fingertip purple and broken, and he finishes the remaining events with it. Bakugo charges him and Aizawa binds him with the scarf. By canon default Izuku places last; Aizawa then calls the expulsion a logical ruse and sends him to Recovery Girl. Nobody else is hurt.

Narrator only: Aizawa notes each student's result once, as they finish an event; after the player's turn his eyes and his clipboard are on whoever is testing, not on the player. The softball throw is never skipped or summarized: Izuku's second throw uses his Quirk through one fingertip for 705.3 m, the fingertip purple and broken. The player does all eight events too; Aizawa calls the last event or the ranking only after all eight of the player's results are in. Uraraka's infinity is the top ball throw; Izuku's 705.3 m is second. The eight: 50 m dash, grip strength, standing long jump, side steps, ball throw, endurance run, sit-ups, seated toe-touch. A finished event is never redone or retried unless the player asks.
